name: clear-straight-sustain-pace-v1

factor.implementation: subclass _LaunchThrottleController and override only CLEAR_STRAIGHT_MAX_GAS from0.10 to0.11; route only bare state-dict inference to the subclass
factor.exact_predicate: the inherited action is gas-positive and brake-zero, the exact straight classifier is true, the current obstacle detector returns None, and abs(previous steer) is at most MAX_STEER_STEP0.07
factor.control_scaling: min(base_gas*(0.10/0.08),0.10), followed by the existing launch-only0.11 override for base full gas
factor.candidate_scaling: min(base_gas*(0.11/0.08),0.11), followed by the unchanged launch-only0.11 override

frozen: cruise48, all target speed values, target EMA, curve formula/floor, obstacle targets and parent compound target30
MAX_GAS0.08, launch maximum emitted gas0.11, MAX_BRAKE0.28 and every pedal threshold
straight classifier, road/obstacle perception, steering, slew, pass-side, urgency, preview and obstacle-priority state
invalid/lost-road behavior, model.pt, DrQ, explicit export, HAIC policy, official environment, active padding study, user artifacts and root submission.zip

synthetic: Close exact and nextafter speed boundaries40,45 and49 on settled obstacle-free straight frames.
Full-gas launch remains exactly0.11; only mid and low gas branches rise to the preregistered values; overspeed brake remains complete-action exact.
Exact residual previous-steer boundary0.07 applies and nextafter above is complete-action exact.
For every intentional delta, steering, brake, target speed and all controller state remain exact; gas is finite, at most0.11 and mutually exclusive with brake.
Curves, previews, straight and curved obstacles, raw36 compound hazards at inherited target30, detector miss/reacquire, invalid input, road loss and reset remain complete-action/state exact.
Randomized differential frames permit differences only under the exact registered predicate and only in gas.
regression: All prior corridor, inference and local contract tests pass.
Bare state-dict routing selects only the new final subclass; explicit export, DrQ and HAIC routes remain unchanged.
A temporary package with exact candidate agent.py and unchanged model.pt passes static interface/import, initialization, reset, action, latency and size smoke without overwriting root submission.zip.

future_environment_gate.required_before_claim: After governance restoration, preregister unused geometry seeds across multiple track IDs and compare against the exact frozen control. Require no completion-rate, DNF, collision or worst-progress regression before considering lap time.
future_environment_gate.target_metric: For valid finishes only, low-20-second range is an internal objective; report the full per-cell distribution and do not represent this factor alone as sufficient to reach it.

rejected_alternatives: Clear-straight transient target64 was rejected because it moved braking from speed49 to above65, amplified detector misses and bypassed target smoothing.
Global cruise speed, curve floor/penalty, MAX_GAS, steering gain/slew and inside-line changes were rejected because they alter curve or obstacle safety and confound the active DNF mechanism.
abort: Any track ID, seed, coordinate, time, progress or memorized map condition is introduced.
Any target speed, brake, steering, perception, state, curve, obstacle or non-bare route changes.
Emitted gas exceeds0.11 or any difference occurs on full-gas launch, overspeed brake, curve, detected obstacle, invalid or roadless frames.
The value0.11 is retuned after synthetic or consumed-run feedback.
Any frozen environment/model/DrQ/active-study artifact or user evidence changes, or an interface/package gate fails.
Any environment execution, training, completion/lap-time claim, submission or SOTA action occurs while governance documents remain absent.
compliance_blockers: SOTA.md, RESULTS.md, COMPETITION_INFO.md, RESTRICTIONs.md and report.pdf are absent.
The competition website is inaccessible and the official repository provides no fixed map list, public evaluation seeds or official target time.
